PHLEGM.gloss: apathy demonstrated by an absence of emotional reactions
PHLEGM.definition: Apathy demonstrated by an absence of emotional reactions.

HELP.definition: Give help or assistance; be of service.
HELP.example: Everyone helped out during the earthquake.

HELM.definition: Steering mechanism for a vessel; a mechanical device by which a vessel is steered.

LEG.definition: A human limb; commonly used to refer to a whole limb but technically only the part of the limb between the knee and ankle.

MPH.gloss: the ratio of the distance traveled to the time spent traveling
MPH.definition: The ratio of the distance traveled (in miles) to the time spent traveling (in hours).

GEM.gloss: art highly prized for its beauty or perfection
GEM.definition: Art highly prized for its beauty or perfection.

GEL.gloss: a colloid in a more solid form than a sol
GEL.definition: A colloid in a more solid form than a sol.
